Name: (AT) Moss's Holiday Houses
Author: MossiMods
Description:
[b]Installation instructions[/b]
Unzip the file into your mods folder

In game during [b][i]WINTER[/i][/b] use the Paint Bucket Tool on your farmhouse's Exterior to choose one 
of these variants

[b]Main features[/b]
6 Winter Season Variants of Farmhouse 3 (the largest Farmhouse, upgrade with Robin the Carpenter)
to make your Farmhouse into a cute, festive Holiday themed house!
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]BONUS!  I included a png of the many parts I used to create them so you can Edit, Recolor, Add onto and build your own custom house or houses if you'd like to! [/b][/size][/color]
[color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Just please make sure you credit ConcernedApe and me, MossiMods [/b][/size][/color]

[color=#cc0000][size=4][b]NO AI USED TO CREATE MY MODS[/b] - Every Mod I make is drawn pixel by pixel[/size][/color]

[b]TIPS:[/b]
[b]If you want to get things built quickly , use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url]

First, Go to the Carpenter on a day and time she is open. Opening the Menu to choose which building to construct will tell you
how much Gold and how many of each material you need to build each building and its upgrade

Use the Item Spawner - Hit "I" on your keyboard and type the item you want into the search bar to instantly spawn it.
example: type in "paint bucket" to get the paint bucket, "wood" to find wood

Now hit "P" on your keyboard to enter the Cheats Menu. 
Go to the "Farm and Fishing" Tab and check the "Instant Build" Box to get buildings from Robin Built Instantly instead of waiting days.
In the "Player and Tools" Tab, scroll down and you can add as much gold as you need to complete a build.
You can also use the Cheats menu to instantly Warp to Robin when you need to using the Warp Locations tab. [/b]

[b][color=#f1c232]If you don't want all 6 variants gumming up your mods folder[/color], delete the variants you don't want.[/b]
[b] If you only keep one, make sure you rename the png "texture" (without the quotation marks of course).[/b]
[b]If you keep more than one variant, rename the pngs in order from texture_1 to up to however many variants you kept. [/b]

Example: if you keep 3 of them, rename them texture_1 , texture_2, and texture_3.

Then open the texture.json file that's inside the folder with the pngs of the houses and change the number of Variations at the bottom
of the document to the number of variations you decided to keep and save it !  

[b]Requirements[/b]
Alternative Textures
SMAPI

[b]Shout outs[/b]
ConcernedApe for all the original game assets
